answer: Re-attestations are stored in dawn and raven lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the gale graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 198 impostors cost 1103 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
